system.description:
A powerful and singularly willed creature, brutes are enormous in both size and power. Your chosen Brute Form should be a powerful solitary land beast no more than eight feet in length, such as a short-faced bear, a smilodon, a dire boar, a giant sloth, or a tiger.

Hulinari are both an Ancestry and a Profession: if you choose to play one, you must take the other. Every Hulinari Ancestry is a unique animal; choose your species. This also sets your Hulinari Warrior form.

Abilities: @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.45d2e84fc7d1bbbf]{Beastly Fortitude}, @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.67b5054b2edf4134]{With Force}

Hulinari Heritage. Rulebook p.92.
